ORBIT cartridge player — EmulatorJS 4.2.3

EmulatorJS copyright Ethan O’Brien and contributors. GPL-3.0-or-later.
Unmodified upstream scripts, styles, decompression tools and selected prebuilt
cores come from the official v4.2.3 release:
https://github.com/EmulatorJS/EmulatorJS/releases/tag/v4.2.3
Frontend source and build instructions:
https://github.com/EmulatorJS/EmulatorJS/tree/e150dc0491ae747028919fb82d6598954976ede6
Core / RetroArch source and build system:
https://github.com/EmulatorJS/build
https://github.com/EmulatorJS/RetroArch

See COPYING and licenses/<core>/license.txt. Each core retains its own
license conditions. Snes9x includes noncommercial distribution conditions.
Stella 2014’s license is provided separately from the upstream core source.
No commercial ROMs, console firmware or BIOS files are bundled.
Core source repositories:
  fceumm: https://github.com/EmulatorJS/libretro-fceumm
  snes9x: https://github.com/EmulatorJS/snes9x
  mupen64plus_next: https://github.com/EmulatorJS/mupen64plus-libretro-nx
  picodrive: https://github.com/EmulatorJS/picodrive
  stella2014: https://github.com/EmulatorJS/stella2014-libretro

The ORBIT adapter source at ../../arcade-engine.js and ../../arcade-engine.html
is licensed GPL-3.0-or-later. It disables database/save persistence and routes
controllers through the room’s player seats. The upstream files here are
unmodified. SHA256SUMS.json records the upstream files in this distribution.
